verdict.rationale: Requesty's own Fallback Policies automatically retry a failed request (timeout, rate limit, error) by moving to the next model in a configured chain. That covers automatic recovery from transient provider errors, but the evidence frames it as failover to different models, not a tunable retry policy. missing for 10: same-model/same-provider retry configuration, retry count and backoff settings, per-error-type retry rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can set automatic retry policies for transient provider errors

citations.quote: Fallback Policies automatically retry your requests with different models if one fails, ensuring your application stays reliable even when individual providers have issues.
If it fails (timeout, rate limit, error, etc.), the router immediately tries the next model in the chain.
